g.ns14:text:
Parameter space: fixed or varying.

Geometry: pitch, cd, h, t, $\mathrm{swa}_{l}$, $\mathrm{swa}_{r}$, $r_{top,l}$, $r_{top,r}$, $r_{bot,l}$, $r_{bot,r}$

Material: targets with different relative permittivities. $1-\mathrm{Re}[\varepsilon_r]$, $\mathrm{Im}[\varepsilon_r]$. 

Layered medium and substrate.

Source: wavelength $\lambda$, plane wave or beam type (coherent). Incident angles.
Numerical data with noise. \n\nPoisson/Gaussian error model.
